subject: Supplier security evidence + PO routing instructions
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@avalogistics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@avalogistics.com
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier security evidence + PO routing instructions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for picking up Ava Logistics as a new supplier — I was asked to gather a few items so procurement can route the PO and get us scheduled for the integration:

- Signed DPA (redacted version ok?)
- SOC 2 Type II report or a hosted link we can share with our security team
- Current subprocessor list (CSV preferred)
- Any vendor onboarding checklist your finance team needs for PO/invoice routing (billing address, remittance, contact)

I attached our completed security survey (Ava_Logistics_Security_Survey_Responses.xlsx) to speed things along. Our target is to have the PO issued by next week; can you confirm what format the PO should reference and where to send it?

Quick Q: does Redwood accept a scanned signed PO emailed to procurement@redwood.com, or do you require DocuSign?

Appreciate it — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Tom Reyes
Procurement Lead
Ava Logistics
attachments: Ava_Logistics_Security_Survey_Responses.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@avalogistics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier security evidence + PO routing instructions

Hi Tom — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the survey.

Summary / next steps from our side:

1) DPA: I attached the current Redwood DPA (Redwood_DPA_v2.0.pdf). If legal at Ava needs redlines, please send them to contracts@redwood.ai and loop me.

2) SOC 2: We host the latest SOC 2 Type II report at a secure link — file name in attachments (SOC2-TypeII-Report-Link.txt) with a one-time access token. If your security team needs a full PDF we can provide it via access-controlled SharePoint.

3) Subprocessors: I'll pull the most up-to-date subprocessor export (CSV) and send it in a follow-up email by EOD tomorrow.

4) PO routing: Our finance team prefers the PO to include the Redwood deal id (DL-2026-0821) and be sent to procurement@redwood.com. If you include the billing contact and remittance address on the PO that speeds processing. We accept either emailed scanned POs or DocuSign envelopes; emailed scanned copies are OK for activation, but for AR we prefer the signed PDF attached to the DocuSign envelope.

Can you confirm the name/email of the person who will send the PO and whether your AP team needs a W-9?

I'll loop Ben (sales) for activation timing and Marcus (finance) for invoicing.

Thanks,

—
Kimberly Park
Sr. Strategic Account Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
attachments: Redwood_DPA_v2.0.pdf, SOC2-TypeII-Report-Link.txt
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier security evidence + PO routing instructions

Kim / Marcus — quick internal note on timing and activation:

- Sales can approve a 30-day activation window once procurement confirms PO intent (we can enable service scoped to test traffic while AR finalizes).
- Finance (Marcus) — please confirm the exact billing address and whether we need an AP vendor form from Ava. If they upload a signed PO to procurement@redwood.com, route to accounts-payable@redwood.ai with the deal id in the subject.
- For DocuSign, we accept envelope completion but it slows AR by ~2 business days vs emailed signed PDF attached to the PO.

Marcus: I attached the internal PO routing instructions for reference (PO-routing-instructions.pdf).

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
attachments: PO-routing-instructions.pdf

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the details. Quick update from our side:

- We've uploaded a signed PO (PO-signed-AVA-0821.pdf) to our vendor portal and sent the signed copy to procurement@redwood.com. The PO references DL-2026-0821.
- I attached the completed security survey (see earlier) and added a note asking for the subprocessor CSV. Could you send the subprocessor list as CSV? Our security team prefers that format for ingestion.
- Regarding SOC 2: the team is okay with the hosted link, but they asked whether the report contains vendor contact info or whether you can provide a redacted PDF that removes internal IP addresses.

If you can confirm receipt of the PO and send the subprocessor CSV, we can move to scheduling the onboarding call next week.

Thanks,
Tom Reyes
Procurement Lead
Ava Logistics
